_comment: Floci AZ 0.17.0 read-back gaps. A re-plan shows these as changes although nothing changed. They are reported as BLOCKED (emulator limitation) by tests and are NEVER applied locally by scripts/spoke.sh (which would destroy the running k3s cluster / PostgreSQL). Production configuration is not altered to hide them.

deviations.reason: Floci ACR always reads back publicNetworkAccess=Enabled; a private-only registry cannot be represented.
Floci managedClusters GET omits networkProfile, apiServerAccessProfile (private cluster + private DNS zone) and agentPoolProfiles[].type; all are ForceNew in azurerm.
Floci flexibleServers GET omits network.delegatedSubnetResourceId (VNet-integrated private access), which is ForceNew.
